invariants.rationale: At least one of the objects must be non-null to return a non-null result.
If templateObject is non-null, it is expected to be an object so its children can be iterated.
If parentObject is non-null, it is expected to be an object so its children can be iterated.
If templateObject has children, their names are used as map keys.
If parentObject has children, their names are used as map keys.
